origin.description: Look up or register a vignette engine.
origin.usage: vignetteEngine(name, weave, tangle, pattern = NULL, package = NULL, aspell = list())

arguments.name: weave
arguments.text: Weave function. Omit it to look the engine up.

origin.details: Sweave cannot be replaced. A name without a package is an error, except Sweave itself.
origin.value: The engine list: name, package, pattern, weave, tangle, and aspell.

translation.description: Look up or register a vignette engine.
translation.usage: vignette_engine(name, weave=missing, tangle=missing, pattern=None, package=missing, aspell=None)

arguments.name: weave
arguments.text: Weave function. Omit it to look the engine up.

translation.details: Sweave cannot be replaced. A name without a package is an error, except Sweave itself.
translation.value: The engine list: name, package, pattern, weave, tangle, and aspell.
translation.example:
from tools.vignette import vignette_engine
e = vignette_engine("Sweave")
print(e["name"], e["package"], e["pattern"])
